name: Shadcn MultiSelect
summary: Searchable multi-select component for shadcn/ui React projects with grouped options and keyboard navigation.
description: A multi-select component built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. Ships search and filtering, grouped options, select-all, badge display limits, responsive behaviour, and full keyboard and screen-reader support. Installs by copying the source into Next.js, Vite or CRA projects; form integration with React Hook Form and an API reference are documented.
contains: multi-select input with search and built-in filtering
grouped options, disable per option, select-all, duplicate removal
responsive badge limits: mobile 2, tablet 4, desktop 6
full keyboard navigation, ARIA roles and live-region announcements
React Hook Form integration and documented props API
copy-paste install for Next.js, Vite and CRA; MIT license
